time-money-skill-01.target: I can tell and write time to the nearest five minutes from analog and digital clocks.
time-money-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can tell and write time to the nearest five minutes from analog and digital clocks.
time-money-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Reading the minute hand as the number it points to (pointing at 4 → 4 minutes), or mixing up the hour and minute hands. Try this: Count the minute hand by 5s around the clock; check the hour hand is just past the hour.

time-money-skill-02.target: I can use AM and PM (a.m. and p.m.) to tell the time of day for events.
time-money-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can use AM and PM (a.m. and p.m.) to tell the time of day for events.
time-money-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Thinking AM means morning only until 10 o'clock, or that noon is AM. Try this: Use a daily schedule from midnight to midnight; AM is from midnight to noon; PM is from noon to midnight.

time-money-skill-03.target: I can find the value of a group of quarters, dimes, nickels, and pennies and write it with ¢.
time-money-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can find the value of a group of quarters, dimes, nickels, and pennies and write it with ¢.
time-money-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Counting coins by size or number (3 coins = 3¢), or thinking a nickel is worth more than a dime because it is bigger. Try this: Sort the coins from greatest to least value, then skip count (25s, 10s, 5s, 1s).

time-money-skill-04.target: I can find the value of dollar bills and coins together and write it with $ and ¢.
time-money-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can find the value of dollar bills and coins together and write it with $ and ¢.
time-money-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Writing $ and ¢ in the same amount ($35¢), or adding dollars and cents as if they were the same unit. Try this: Count the bills first in dollars, then the coins in cents; write dollars with $ and cents with ¢.

time-money-skill-05.target: I can solve word problems about money, including finding totals, change, and how much more is needed.
time-money-skill-05.ifCorrect: You can do this: can solve word problems about money, including finding totals, change, and how much more is needed.
time-money-skill-05.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Adding when the problem asks how much is left or how much more is needed. Try this: Draw the coins or a bar model of the total and the part spent, then decide which part is unknown.
